title: [3.0-beta/2.8.2.18-dev] NSClient Profile display (window top) is not always updated according to the stored profile.
symptom: When a profile is changed in AAPS (e.g., DIA from 7.0h to 9.0h) and activated, the profile display in NSClient is not always updated, even though the profile in NSClient is updated. The issue occurs when the second phase of profile editing is started soon after the first phase, but not if waiting 1-2 minutes.
cause: The issue is related to Nightscout synchronization; events must be at least 1 minute apart for proper sync.
fix: Use the Nightscout dev branch for proper sync, as stated by MilosKozak: 'currently NS dev branch is needed for proper sync'.
evidence_quote: currently NS dev branch is needed for proper sync
